verdict.rationale: Logseq's export docs say the entire graph can be exported as standard Markdown, JSON, EDN, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML, which covers the open, portable formats this story asks for. Community users describe local data and Git-based file backups. They also note caveats: the native Markdown files add indentation that other tools such as Obsidian don't read cleanly, and the new DB version stops keeping data as plain Markdown files. Missing for 10: documentation of the JSON/EDN export structure, hands-on confirmation that exports are complete and import cleanly elsewhere, interoperable native Markdown storage, and clarity on file-based ownership in the DB version.
